purpose: Above-the-fold hero background for an Industrial RFID systems landing page; headline + wordmark overlaid in code.
audience: automation engineers, plant managers, OEM design teams
message: Industrial RFID systems for reliable traceability on the factory floor.

format.safe_area: left third open for code-overlaid headline + top-left wordmark

visual_direction.style: silver-gray Balluff Room register — engineered, clean, technical; premium B2B abstraction
visual_direction.subject: an abstract industrial stage: a silver-gray engineered architectural space with soft directional light and clean material surfaces, an RFID read/write head subtly present at 45deg with a soft rim-light product glow, a single sparse accent of small red dots suggesting the digital/connected signal
visual_direction.composition: asymmetric focal cluster right-of-center, generous negative space on the left for overlay copy, dynamic angle, never centered
visual_direction.lighting: soft directional, cool-neutral, subtle product glow rim-light + clean floor drop shadow

brand.palette: achromatic silver-gray; near-monochrome; at most a small Balluff Red accent

must_avoid: any logo or wordmark (overlaid in code)
